create_train_keyboard: create and train an option keyboard agent for a specified number of episodes with default policy weights
create_train_keyboard_custom_weights: create and train an option keyboard agent with custom policy weights and export the trained model
create_train_keyboard_with_phi: create and train an option keyboard agent using a learned phi model for state representation
create_train_keyboard_with_phi_export: create and train an option keyboard with a learned phi model and export the agent to a path
review_keyboard_agent_config: review the keyboard agent configuration including network sizes epsilon discount and optimizer settings
